test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: what was the theme of ‘Vigilance Awareness Week’ observed from 28 October to 3°4 November 2024, which is an initiatives of the Central Vigilance Commission in the fight against corruption?

options.text: Say No to Corruption; Commit to the Nation
Culture of Integrity for Nation's Prosperity
Corruption Free India for a Developed National

solution:
The correct answer is __**Culture of Integrity for Nation's Prosperity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme **"Culture of Integrity for Nation's Prosperity"** underscores the importance of fostering a culture of **integrity** to achieve overall **prosperity** and development for the nation.
 
• This theme highlights the role of **moral values, ethics, and integrity** in combating corruption and promoting transparent governance.
 
• It aims to encourage individuals and organizations to **commit** to ethical practices and uphold the highest standards of honesty and integrity.
 
• The **Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)** organizes the Vigilance Awareness Week annually to promote vigilance and integrity among public servants and citizens.
 
• By emphasizing a culture of integrity, the theme seeks to create a society where corruption is not tolerated, and every individual plays a role in eradicating it.
 
• Promoting integrity helps in building trust in public institutions and contributes to **nation-building** efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Satark Bharat, Samriddh Bharat**__

 __
 
• This theme translates to **"Vigilant India, Prosperous India."**
 
• It was used in the past for Vigilance Awareness Week to emphasize the need for vigilance to achieve prosperity.
 
 
 
• **Say No to Corruption; Commit to the Nation**__
 __
 
• This theme focuses on encouraging individuals to **reject corruption** and pledge their commitment to the nation.
 
• It aims to raise awareness about the adverse effects of corruption on national development.
 
 
 
• **Corruption Free India for a Developed Nation**__
 
 
• This theme underscores the need to eliminate corruption to achieve the goal of a **developed nation**.
 
• It highlights the correlation between a corruption-free environment and national progress.
